toegepas.na: Die mense onder Shaka se beheer
toegepas.rede_vinder: The block opens with a pronoun whose referent is only in the previous block; naming Shaka makes the block clear on its own.
toegepas.fout: The block opens with 'sy' whose referent stands only in the previous block.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming Shaka anchors the block on its own without adding information, since Shaka is the referent the pronoun already meant.

laat_vaar.voor: Dit het ook op beeste, eerbetoon en die handel gerus.
laat_vaar.na: Dit het ook op beeste, eerbetoon en die handel berus.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The previous sentence says 'berus'; using the same verb in the paired sentence reads more smoothly and avoids a needless switch.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Rus op' and 'berus op' are equally correct and natural, and 'gerus' echoes the block heading; this is a lateral move (the reverse swap was already rejected).

laat_vaar.voor: Hulle weerspreek mekaar soms en oordryf dinge.
laat_vaar.na: Hulle het mekaar soms weerspreek en dinge oordryf.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The traders are historical people described in the past tense in the surrounding sentences; the past tense keeps the tense consistent.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The present tense describes what the written accounts still do today for the historians reading them; the past tense moves that meaning to the writers' own time.

vlae.teks: Lank voor Shaka het 'n vroeë opperhoof mag gehad as mense hom wou volg.
vlae.rede: 'as' can be read as 'when' or 'if', and the sentence does not make clear that the point is that the chief's power depended on people choosing to follow him; clarifying it (e.g. with 'net' or 'solank') would add a qualifier, so the writer should decide the intended meaning.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Die koning, sy izinduna en sy krygers
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: gedra, dus was baie beeste nodig
laat_vaar_vorige.na: gedra, en daarom was baie beeste nodig
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Dus' after a bare comma is a run-on; 'en daarom' links the two clauses properly, with the AWS comma before 'en'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: ', dus was' is accepted Afrikaans for a consequence; 'en daarom' only reads differently.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Lank voor Shaka het 'n vroeë opperhoof
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Lank voor Shaka se tyd het 'n opperhoof
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Lank voor Shaka se tyd' is the natural phrase, and 'vroeë' then only repeats 'lank voor'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Lank voor Shaka' already reads well, and dropping 'vroeë' loses a word that carries information about the kind of leader.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The next sentence and the block heading use 'gerus'; one verb throughout avoids suggesting two different ideas.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Berus op' is the exact, natural verb; swapping it for 'gerus' is lateral and only adds repetition with the next sentence.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Handel met Britse en Portugese handelaars (kaart)
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Op albei plekke is met handelaars handel gedryf.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Op albei plekke is daar met handelaars handel gedryf.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: An impersonal passive reads more naturally with 'daar'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: With 'Op albei plekke' in first position 'daar' is optional, so the change is lateral.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: waarvan 'n olifant se slagtande gemaak is
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Gemaak is' suggests someone made the tusks; 'bestaan uit' is the natural way to say what something consists of.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Waarvan ... gemaak is' is the normal Afrikaans for 'made of' and implies no maker; this is a glossary definition and the original has no real fault.
